title: 風神雷神・新雷神全順位v2 3連単上位6/8/12/18/24点の独立紙上比較

calculation.retro_holdout_caution: Date Oct 12 was previously inspected; it is not an unseen prospective holdout.

evaluation_notes: Do NOT equate signal fire/high-payout capture with winning 3-exact ticket capture.
Number of races is kept fixed across 6/8/12/18/24 point strategies within every comparison cohort.
Past official information recovered after close is present; research ROI cannot be represented as real-time purchasable ROI.
A profitable one-day or one-class strategy is not sufficient evidence to change production betting logic.
Refunds, cancellations and actual stake adjustments not reconstructed from this subset; only three-exact bets with valid payout are modeled.

decisions.next_study: Compare per-signal 6/8/12/18/24 across unseen prospective days and predeadline-only evidence; focus F1R3 18 vs 24.
